# checksum-record: recorded digests. a checksum authenticates content, it does not authorise access.
# the hex here is generated by the test, so the repository holds no opaque literal.
# known gap: a value that glues a prefix to the digest, `Digest: sha-256=<64 hex>` (RFC 3230) or
# `digest: sha256:<64 hex>`, is reported. the mixed value clears the entropy gate and the hash
# context guard only governs the hex bypass. add those lines here once the layer covers them.
sha256: {HEX64}
etag: "{HEX32}"
md5sum = "{HEX32}"
    "integrity_sha256": "{HEX64}"
blake3 checksum {HEX64} verified
Digest: {HEX64}
X-Checksum-Sha256: {HEX64}
content_hash: {HEX64}
    checksum = "{HEX64}"
file_md5: {HEX32}
